infobox.usage: Unlocks the door to the parking garage alarm system control room in The Lab.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: TerraGroup Labs keycard (Yellow) (Yellow) is a Keycard in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A United Security-issued TerraGroup Labs keycard for technicians in the Yellow sector.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text:
- Only 5 can be held in a raid inventory at the same time
- The alarm system control panel can be used to disable the announcement that plays upon activating the "Parking Gate" extraction. Scav Raiders can still spawn.
